text.name: Dratini

attacks.name: Wrap
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

text.flavor: It is called the "Mirage Pokémon" because so few have seen it. Its shed skin has been found.

text.name: Dratini

attacks.name: Hypnotic Gaze
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon is now Asleep.

text.flavor: It is called the "Mirage Pokémon" because so few have seen it. Its shed skin has been found.

text.name: Dragonair

attacks.name: Dragon Pulse
attacks.text: Discard the top card of your deck.

text.flavor: If its body takes on an aura, the weather changes instantly. It is said to live in seas and lakes.

text.name: Dragonair

attacks.name: Healing Melody
attacks.text: Heal 10 damage from each of your Pokémon.

attacks.name: Slam
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 30 damage times the number of heads.

text.flavor: If its body takes on an aura, the weather changes instantly. It is said to live in seas and lakes.

text.name: Dragonite

attacks.name: Hyper Beam
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, discard an Energy attached to the Defending Pokémon.

attacks.name: Hurricane Tail
attacks.text: Flip 4 coins. This attack does 60 damage times the number of heads.

text.flavor: It is said to make its home somewhere in the sea. It guides crews of shipwrecks to shore.

text.name: Bagon
text.flavor: Dreaming of one day flying, it practices by leaping off cliffs every day.

text.name: Shelgon

attacks.name: Knock Away
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 20 more damage.

text.flavor: Within its rugged shell, its cells have begun changing. The shell peels off the instant it evolves.

text.name: Salamence

abilities.label: Ability
abilities.name: Scornful Storm
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may have your opponent discard cards from his or her hand until he or she has 4 cards left in his or her hand.

attacks.name: Shred
attacks.text: This attack's damage isn't affected by any effects on the Defending Pokémon.

text.flavor: As a result of its long-held dream of flying, its cellular structure changed, and wings grew out.

text.name: Latias

attacks.name: Energy Assist
attacks.text: Attach a basic Energy card from your discard pile to 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

attacks.name: Sky Heal
attacks.text: If Latios is on your Bench, heal 20 damage from this Pokémon.

text.flavor: Its body is covered with a down that can refract light in such a way that it becomes invisible.

text.name: Latios

attacks.name: Sky Blade
attacks.text: If Latias is on your Bench, this attack does 20 more damage.

text.flavor: A highly intelligent Pokémon. By folding back its wings in flight, it can overtake jet planes.

text.name: Rayquaza

attacks.name: Dragon Pulse
attacks.text: Discard the top 2 cards of your deck.

attacks.name: Shred
attacks.text: This attack's damage isn't affected by any effects on the Defending Pokémon.

text.flavor: It lives in the ozone layer far above the clouds and cannot be seen from the ground.

text.name: Axew

attacks.name: Signs of Evolution
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, search your deck for Fraxure, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward.

text.flavor: They use their tusks to crush the berries they eat. Repeated regrowth makes their tusks strong and sharp.

text.name: Axew

attacks.name: Lunge
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.

text.flavor: They mark their territory by leaving gashes in trees with their tusks. If a tusk breaks, a new one grows in quickly.

text.name: Fraxure

abilities.label: Ability
abilities.name: Grit
abilities.text: If this Pokémon is affected by a Special Condition, each of its attacks does 40 more damage (before applying Weakness and Resistance).

text.flavor: Since a broken tusk will not grow back, they diligently sharpen their tusks on river rocks after they've been fighting.

text.name: Fraxure
text.flavor: Their tusks can shatter rocks. Territory battles between Fraxure can be intensely violent.

text.name: Haxorus

attacks.name: Axe Slugger
attacks.text: If the Defending Pokémon is a {Colorless} Pokémon, this attack does 60 more damage.

attacks.name: Dragon Pulse
attacks.text: Discard the top card of your deck.

text.flavor: They are kind but can be relentless when defending territory. They challenge foes with tusks that can cut steel.

text.name: Druddigon

attacks.name: Tight Jaw
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

attacks.name: Dragon Tail
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 80 damage times the number of heads.

text.flavor: It races through narrow caves, using its sharp claws to catch prey. The skin on its face is harder than a rock.

text.name: Exp. Share
effect: When your Active Pokémon is Knocked Out by damage from an opponent's attack, you may move 1 basic Energy card that was attached to that Pokémon to the Pokémon this card is attached to.

rules.label: Pokémon Tool
rules.text: Attach a Pokémon Tool to 1 of your Pokémon that doesn't already have a Pokémon Tool attached to it.
You may play as many Item cards as you like during your turn (before your attack).

text.name: First Ticket
effect: Before you flip a coin to decide who goes first in a game, you may play this card. Don't flip that coin, and you go first. If both players play First Ticket, flip the coin as normal. (You may play only 1 First Ticket before you flip that coin.)

rules.text: You may play as many Item cards as you like during your turn (before your attack).

text.name: Super Rod
effect: Shuffle 3 in any combination of Pokémon and basic Energy cards from your discard pile back into your deck.

rules.text: You may play as many Item cards as you like during your turn (before your attack).

text.name: Kyurem

attacks.name: Blizzard
attacks.text: Does 10 damage to each of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

text.flavor: It can produce ultracold air. Its body is frozen.
